items.description: Convert class parameter defaults from init.pp to Ansible defaults: redis_port (6379), redis_password (CHANGEME → vault-encrypted), maxmemory_mb (2048), maxmemory_policy (allkeys-lru)
items.notes: Converted Puppet class parameters to Ansible defaults. redis_password and redis_service_token are AAP credential variables, not in defaults.

items.description: Role argument specs for fail-fast parameter validation (generate after defaults/main.yml is written)
items.notes: Generated argument_specs.yml from defaults/main.yml plus AAP credential variables (redis_password, redis_service_token) marked as required with no default.

items.description: Convert init.pp to main tasks: resolve redis_role fact (stat+slurp+set_fact), fetch health check via uri module, write health_check.json, deploy myapp artifact (get_url+unarchive+copy version.txt), fetch service token (custom lookup), register node in Enterprise Scheduler (schedulerctl), include install tasks. PuppetDB cluster discovery → use dynamic inventory group redis_cluster.
items.notes: Fixed Cat4 ordering: moved include_tasks install.yml to run immediately after credential validation, before any task using redis user/group or /var/lib/redis. Fixed Cat2: added stat+assert guard for schedulerctl binary.

items.description: Convert install.pp: install redis package, write /etc/redis/redis.conf (bind, port, requirepass, maxmemory, appendonly, appendfsync), manage redis service, create /var/log/redis directory (owner redis, group redis, mode 0755)
items.notes: Converted Puppet redis class include and file resource to Ansible tasks. Created redis.conf.j2 template. redis_password uses AAP credential variable with no_log.

items.description: Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via ansible.builtin.include_role
items.notes: Generated converge.yml with single include_role task for profile_redis_cluster_case2. Includes AAP credential vars (redis_password, redis_service_token) as molecule test values.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, owner redis, mode 0644, valid JSON), /var/log/redis (directory, owner redis, mode 0755), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), /opt/myapp/ (exists), schedulerctl status redis-node, redis-cli ping on port 6379
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 4 plays: (1) filesystem artifact stat/assert checks, (2) file content slurp/assert checks (version.txt, health_check.json, redis.conf), (3) Redis service facts and port 6379 wait_for, (4) schedulerctl binary and scheduler registration checks.
